adjudication.rationale: In lib/tasks/disqus.thor the importer now does `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])` and then, if `post.present?`, iterates `t[:posts]` to add replies. `TopicEmbed.import_remote` delegates to `TopicEmbed.import`, which (a) returns `nil` for non-http(s) URLs (`return unless url =~ /^https?\:\/\//`) and (b) returns the existing first post when a `TopicEmbed` row for the URL already exists (via `embed = TopicEmbed.where(embed_url: url).first` then `post = embed.post`). Because `topic_embeds.embed_url` is unique, re-running the Disqus importer for the same thread link will reuse the existing topic/post and append the replies again, creating duplicate replies in that existing topic.
